name: @absolutejs/isolated-jsc
description: JavaScriptCore-native sandbox for Bun — heap-isolated execution for untrusted code, isolated-vm-shaped API
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts src/worker.ts src/doctor.ts --outdir dist --sourcemap --target=bun && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check:package: bun run typecheck && bun run build && bun run test && bun run example:agent-tool
scripts.check:examples: cd ../examples/isolated-jsc && bun run typecheck && PORT=3564 bun run test
scripts.check:release: bun run check:package && bun run check:examples
scripts.release: bun run format && bun run check:release && bun publish
